mainEntity.name: Do I need to prime wall panels before painting them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, priming wall panels before painting is generally recommended, especially for raw wood or MDF panels. Primer creates a uniform surface, ensures better paint adhesion, and helps to prevent the absorption of paint into porous materials, leading to a smoother, more consistent finish. For certain pre-finished panels, priming might not be necessary, but it's always best to consult the manufacturer's recommendations. Hometelligent Inc. includes professional priming as part of our finishing process to achieve the highest quality painted result for your paneling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, priming wall panels, especially raw wood or MDF, is usually recommended to ensure better paint adhesion and a smoother finish. Hometelligent Inc. incorporates professional priming in its finishing process.
